Description: The StrideMax Dual FD is a dual TMC5160 expansion board built around the RP2040 microcontroller. It adds two high-current stepper channels to an existing Klipper or RRF setup via CAN, CANFD, or USB. Each channel supports up to 10A continuous and 60V max, making it the standard solution for adding AWD motor channels or upgrading to 48V on a Voron 2.4 or VzBoT build without replacing the main control board.
Verdict Label: The cleanest way to add AWD or 48V to an existing Voron or VzBoT build.
Cons:
Not a standalone board — requires an existing controller
Larger physical footprint (91x80mm) — DIN rail mount only
Requires CAN configuration knowledge
Not suitable for toolhead mounting
